- `report.js`: the report header
- `export.js`: the CSV date column
- `email.js`: the reminder email subject

I added a shared `date.js` with a `formatDate` helper that outputs `YYYY-MM-DD` and pads month and day to two digits. All three files now call it instead of their own formatting code. I also added a test for a January date (`2026-01-09`) to cover the padding case.

I ran the tests through Bash because the PowerShell call was denied in this session. I haven't checked `export.js` or `email.js` with a test; they only changed through the shared helper.
